verdict.rationale: Pipecat ships official SDKs: the open-source Python framework (pipecat-ai on PyPI, verified installable by probe) and the Pipecat Clients family of web and mobile SDKs, including prebuilt React components. These are backed by a semver changelog with staged deprecations and a 1.0 migration guide. missing for 10: no official client SDK for the Pipecat Cloud REST API (only a downloadable OpenAPI spec for generating clients), no enumeration of which client SDK languages and platforms exist, no independent hands-on corroboration of the client SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Pipecat Clients are a family of SDKs that connect users to your Pipecat agents through web and mobile applications.
